title: Placement-mode escape / backdrop recovery

root_cause.decoupling: placementModeActive (store intent) and openPanel (React panel visibility) were fully decoupled; entering placement never set openPanel and cancelling placement never cleared openPanel
root_cause.orphan_trap: if a floating panel was open around placement, cancel showed 'Placement cancelled' but left the transparent backdrop mounted (openPanel still set) with pointer-events:auto, blocking the Bentley canvas; the only Escape handler that could dismiss it was gated on openPanel and unaware of placement

fix.authoritative_state: unchanged single source of truth (SpatialAssetStore.intent); no competing boolean introduced
fix.app_stable_escape: window-level capture-phase keydown handler in BentleyViewer.tsx, always mounted post-auth, not gated on openPanel, not dependent on Bentley active tool; single Escape cancels placement AND closes any open panel atomically; guarded against text-field editing
fix.backdrop_never_orphaned: backdropMayMount gates .viewer-panel-backdrop to (open panel AND not placing); shouldCloseFloatingPanelOnPlacementArmed closes any open panel the moment placement arms
fix.backdrop_ux: no dim during placement; BIM stays visible; subtle .mrt-placement-status guidance banner retained
fix.cancel_atomic: one cancelPlacement() clears intent + exits Bentley tool; no partial-cleanup functions

cases.A: PLACE IN MODEL -> ARMED -> placement UI visible
cases.C: cancelPlacement() called (all temporary placement state cleared)
cases.E: Escape works with no Bentley tool active (window-level, tool-independent)
cases.F: Escape while focus over Asset Library still cancels
cases.G: Escape while focus over viewport (no text field) still cancels
cases.H: re-enter placement after cancel works 3x, no orphaned state/backdrop
cases.I: existing placed assets unchanged by cancel

results.build_warnings: pre-existing (chunk size + ineffective-dynamic-import), unrelated to this change

manual_sequence: Repeat 3 times to prove no orphaned listener/state
